title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON THE KOREA DEMOCRACY FOUNDATION
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON THE KOREA DEMOCRACY FOUNDATION

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated under the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof. <Amended on Oct. 30, 2013>

Article 2 (Democratization Movements)
The term "activities prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 2 of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation means any of the following activities: <Amended on Oct. 20, 2008; Jun. 28, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 30, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
1. The February 28 Daegu Democratization Movement, March 8 Daejeon Democratic Uprising, March 15 Uprising, April 19 Revolution, June 3 Movement opposing the Korea-Japan Talks, movement opposing the constitutional amendment permitting a third presidential term, movement opposing the Yushin Constitution, Bu-Ma Democratic Uprising, Gwangju Democratization Movement, and June 10 Democratic Uprising;
2. A democratization movement under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Act on the Restoration of Honor and Compensation to Persons Related to Democratization Movements, limited to cases in which the Deliberation Committee for the Restoration of Honor and Compensation to Persons Related to Democratization Movements under Article 4 of that Act has deliberated on and determined that a person is related to such a movement;
3. Democratization movements other than those specified in subparagraphs 1 and 2, publicly notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety after hearing opinions from relevant agencies and experts.

Article 3
Deleted. <Oct. 20, 2008>

Article 4
Deleted. <Oct. 20, 2008>

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 17396, Oct. 31, 2001>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 19513, Jun. 12, 2006>
(Regulations on Personnel Management of the Senior Executive Service)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2006.

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (94) Omitted.

(95) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4 (3) 1, "a public official of Grade I or a public official of equivalent rank" shall be replaced with "a general-service public official belonging to the Senior Executive Service or a public official of equivalent rank".

(96) through (241) Omitted.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 21087, Oct. 20, 2008>
(Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Lifelong Education Act, etc. to Reorganize Committees under Administrative Agencies)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 22216, Jun. 28, 2010>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 24425, Mar. 23, 2013>
(Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Security and Public Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees that had been promulgated before this Decree entered into force but had not yet reached their enforcement dates shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (55) Omitted.

(56) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 3, "Minister of the Interior and Safety" shall be replaced with "Minister of Security and Public Administration".

(57) through (129) Omitted.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 24813, Oct. 30, 2013>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 25751, Nov. 19, 2014>
(Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Its Affiliated Agencies)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 5 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree entered into force but whose enforcement dates had not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (161) Omitted.

(162) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 3, "Minister of Security and Public Administration" shall be replaced with "Minister of the Interior".

(163) through (418) Omitted.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 28211, Jul. 26, 2017>
(Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 8 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree entered into force but whose enforcement dates had not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 7

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (126) Omitted.

(127) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 3, "Minister of the Interior" shall be replaced with "Minister of the Interior and Safety".

(128) through (388) Omitted.
